source_name: NASA MAST cached TESS SPOC light-curve products

target_ids.selection: Existing cached SPOC light-curve products after excluding every TIC present in local labeled corpora and the frozen tess_live_search_v1 role

time_range.value: 84 represented TESS sectors spanning sector numbers 1-98

cadence.value: 11,283 standard SPOC light-curve products and 677 fast-cadence SPOC light-curve products

data_product_type: Metadata-only JSONL inventory of cached SPOC light-curve FITS products
license: NASA/STScI public archive data; acknowledge the TESS mission and MAST
label_source: No labels assigned; TICs present in local labeled corpora were excluded
known_caveats: Unlabeled means absent from the project's listed local labeled corpora, not astrophysically label-free
Inventory reflects mutable local cache state at creation time
No FITS payloads or headers were opened and raw products were not hashed
The 29.79762048 GB raw products already existed outside the repository; no data were downloaded
